name: KernelPromptAssembler

test_list.description: Real PII vault masks goal, history and context before any tokenizer request; dispatch receives the counted request.
Count only tools permitted by the actual frame role, including conservative CAS-read classification.
Trim complete old exchanges, persist retrievable archives and count the final notice.
Fail closed for foreign frame, malformed history, unavailable tokenizer and mandatory-prefix overflow.
Bound execution rejects a same-ID active frame with a different selected model or token before reserving a step.
Stalled tokenizers time out; individually fitting candidate archives cannot exceed the cumulative per-assembly byte allowance.
Reject detected sensitive correlation identities and encoded-context expansion before counting.
Mask structured argument values, reasoning and tool results; frame visibility does not grant missing CAS Read rights.
Property-check exact JSON byte accounting including escaped strings and cap boundaries.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Goal and prior transcript for the bound active frame.

output_description: Sanitized role-filtered prompt with actual model input-token count and bounded output budget.
